primary_sources.title: Adobe InDesign stroke settings
primary_sources.bounded_paraphrase: Miter limit selects bevel fallback; caps, joins, alignment, and patterned strokes are distinct controls.

primary_sources.title: Adobe InDesign EndJoin API
primary_sources.bounded_paraphrase: The enumerated joins are miter, round, and bevel. This is a bounded API statement, not an inventory of every possible extension.

primary_sources.title: Adobe Illustrator stroke controls
primary_sources.bounded_paraphrase: Documents ordinary stroke controls and limits alignment choices to closed paths excluding Live Paint groups.

primary_sources.title: Adobe multiple fills and strokes
primary_sources.bounded_paraphrase: Objects/groups can have multiple fills and strokes, including duplicated entries; a single basic stroke value is not a full stack census.

primary_sources.title: Adobe brush families
primary_sources.bounded_paraphrase: Separates calligraphic, scatter, art, bristle, and pattern brushes. Their geometries must not be treated as one uniform-stroke case.

primary_sources.title: Adobe InDesign release notes
primary_sources.bounded_paraphrase: Version boundaries are recorded in UP-ID-01/02. A display-engine update does not prove an export fix.

primary_sources.title: Adobe Illustrator release notes
primary_sources.bounded_paraphrase: Version boundaries are recorded in UP-AI-01/02. An Adobe-listed fix is not a locally verified fix.

primary_sources.title: Adobe InDesign known/fixed issues
primary_sources.bounded_paraphrase: Reviewed as a discovery source; no entry promoted to local StrokeMaster support.
